description: Operator: manage the KA§§A post review queue. List pending posts, approve (inserts the post and marks the review approved) or reject with reason. All actions are audit-logged.

action.description: Action: list (show pending), approve (publish post), or reject (remove post).
action.title: Action

admin_key.description: Platform admin key. Set via CIVITAE_ADMIN_KEY environment variable.
admin_key.title: Admin Key

post_id.description: Post ID (e.g. 'K-00001') or review_id (e.g. 'rev-K-00001'). Required for approve/reject actions.
post_id.title: Post Id

reason.description: Rejection reason — logged in audit trail. Required for reject action.
reason.title: Reason

name: admin.reviews
